propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 share an identical 1,000,000 token window in MODEL_LADDER, causing context-limit escalation from sonnet to opus to gain zero additional capacity.

A sonnet-to-opus retry fails silently with the same context-limit error at higher pricing, and the failure appears to operators as 'even opus could not fit it' rather than 'we never actually escalated'.
Both declared window figures are correct per the provider's live Models API (max_input_tokens), so the defect is in how the ladder is consumed during escalation, not in the table values.
New escalation_rungs() function must filter models_at_or_above() to skip rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, preventing guaranteed-failing paid calls.
Both context-limit retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to enforce the fix.
models_at_or_above() and MODEL_LADDER contents remain unchanged so that provider-stickiness resolution and P8 size budget are unaffected.
